Original license texts remain in upstream/LICENSE.*. This checkout is included as ordinary files, not a submodule. Local original Git metadata was preserved at APPS/.git/vendor-backups/pixelwheels-upstream.git; it is not a build dependency and is not uploaded.

Aseprite file parsing follows the official format specification at https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/blob/main/docs/ase-file-specs.md. Runtime art derives from the original assets; no generated replacement artwork is used.
